integrity: Reproducible finite complete enumeration using outward rational interval bounds, with an analytic phase-gauge reduction; no external independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Only length-seven consecutive Fourier support and integer phase alphabets 2 through 7. It does not give a continuous-phase optimum, larger alphabets, or other lengths; equivalent unindexed small-alphabet studies remain possible.
title: The seven-phase threshold for improved Barker-seven Fourier fourth moments
